items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where did you get the idea for using the glass in the first place, Tom? ... [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Well, I'm going to see y'all later, yeah? Yeah. All right, Tom. All right, Tom.

ctx.x: Yours was the first aluminum one in the city. First aluminum one I ever had, the mother had to use them derbies. But you see that aluminum don't take the place of that derby, man. No. I mean for Tone, that derby, you see that old tarlet plunging? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Man, Chris Kelly, boy, could play your old blues on that. He was the best, he was the best on that. Oh yeah, he was the best on that. That man could make you cry playing the blues. And use the glass, man. Yeah. And that wah-wah and stuff, man, them guys…
Where did you get the idea for using the glass in the first place, Tom?

Oh well, you just have ideas, you know, you try it. Yeah, I'm glad you could try anything. Try anything, you know what I mean? Sounds good like a music show. Something, guys would go on the job and he don't have nothing, the guys would tell me and say that's how they use a bottle, he used to use a bottle. Bottle, dude. They said, man, they didn't have no money to buy no blues and nothing, they just look around saying that thing, they'd grab this and use this and say, I ain't got no mute or can't got no money to…
